summary.text: Mike Drago is the incumbent Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists his tenure in the House as beginning in 2022, and he is a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Drago graduated from Pinkerton Academy and earned a degree in kinesiology from the University of New Hampshire.
His career experience includes owning a landscaping company.
